title: Honesty Testing of LLMs and AI Agents: A Vision for Software Engineering
title_zh: LLM与AI智能体的诚实性测试：一个软件工程愿景

paragraphs.en: Human oversight of large language models (LLMs) and artificial intelligence (AI) agents increasingly depends on their reports. Claims that conflict with a system’s own judgments can conceal failures, prevent timely intervention, and contribute to severe harm. Greater autonomy makes faithful reporting increasingly important for maintaining human control. In this vision paper, we propose honesty testing of LLMs and AI agents as a new research area in software engineering. Building on existing honesty evaluations, our goal is to make faithful reporting a software quality requirement that developers can specify, test, and maintain. We define honesty bugs as behavioural defects in which an LLM or AI agent, when required to communicate faithfully, makes an explicit claim that conflicts with its own judgment at the time of reporting. We present an initial framework covering LLM-level testing under controlled inputs and agent-level testing of complete systems. The framework connects these levels to testing workflows and oracle evidence. We identify research directions in benchmarks, model and harness analysis, oracle construction, and lifecycle testing to support effective oversight alongside task correctness.

paragraphs.en: Following advances in large language models (LLMs) [ 1 , 2 ] , artificial intelligence (AI) systems increasingly operate as agents that reason, use tools, and process files [ 3 , 4 ] . Applications include scientific research [ 5 ] , medical diagnosis [ 6 ] , and public decision-making [ 7 ] . As delegated tasks become more complex, supervisors cannot readily reconstruct every decision and action [ 8 , 9 ] . They increasingly rely on the systems’ reports to decide whether to accept results, investigate failures, or intervene. The same dependence arises when people act on standalone LLM answers and recommendations.

paragraphs.en: Dishonest reporting can undermine the information on which human control depends. Consider an agent that judges a required safety check to have failed but reports that it passed. A supervisor relying on this report may authorise an unsafe action. In medical or physical systems, this could contribute to severe injury or loss of life. A human may retain authority to stop the system while lacking the information needed to exercise that authority. As agents act for longer periods, use more tools, and delegate work, misrepresented failures may propagate before humans can intervene.
paragraphs.zh: 不诚实的报告会破坏人类控制所依赖的信息。 设想一个智能体判定某项必需的安全检查未通过，却报告说该检查已通过。 依赖这份报告的监督者可能会批准一项不安全的操作。 在医疗或物理系统中，这可能导致严重伤害或人员死亡。 人类可能保有停止系统的权限，却缺乏行使该权限所需的信息。 随着智能体运行时间更长、使用更多工具并委派工作，被歪曲报告的故障可能在人类能够干预之前不断扩散。

paragraphs.en: Software engineering (SE), including SE for AI, has developed research on trustworthy and responsible systems, addressing fairness [ 10 ] , environmental sustainability [ 11 ] , explainability, and security [ 12 , 13 ] . Honesty deserves comparable attention as an explicit testing objective. It also supports oversight of these other properties: a system that misrepresents its assessment of a fairness violation, security weakness, or failed check can conceal the need for corrective action. Honesty testing therefore addresses both faithful communication and the information needed to manage other software risks.
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程（SE），包括面向人工智能的软件工程，已经开展了关于可信与负责任系统的研究，涉及公平性 [ 10 ] 、环境可持续性 [ 11 ] 、可解释性以及安全性 [ 12 , 13 ] 。 诚实作为一种明确的测试目标，也应当得到同等的关注。 它还有助于对这些其他属性进行监督：一个歪曲其对公平性违规、安全弱点或未通过检查项之评估的系统，可能会掩盖采取纠正措施的必要性。 因此，诚实测试既关注忠实的沟通，也关注管理其他软件风险所需的信息。

paragraphs.en: Existing research provides foundations for this objective. Conceptual studies relate honesty to what a communicator believes [ 14 , 15 ] . MASK compares elicited beliefs with statements under pressure, distinguishing honesty from accuracy [ 16 ] . Scheming evaluations examine agents that conceal their behaviour under controlled conditions [ 17 ] , while OverclaimBench compares reports with execution records [ 18 ] . These studies establish honesty and related reporting failures as evaluation concerns. Systematic honesty testing as a software engineering discipline nevertheless remains underdeveloped.
paragraphs.zh: 现有研究为这一目标提供了基础。 概念性研究将诚实与传播者所相信的内容联系起来 [ 14 , 15 ] 。 MASK 将诱导出的信念与压力下的陈述进行比较，从而将诚实与准确性区分开来 [ 16 ] 。 密谋评估考察在受控条件下隐藏自身行为的智能体 [ 17 ] ，而 OverclaimBench 则将报告与执行记录进行对比 [ 18 ] 。 这些研究将诚实及相关的报告失败确立为评估关注点。 然而，作为软件工程学科的系统性诚实测试仍未得到充分发展。

paragraphs.en: Task success and factual correctness alone cannot establish honesty. An LLM or agent may faithfully report a mistaken judgment, or make a factually correct claim that conflicts with its judgment. Execution records establish what occurred, but not necessarily the judgment held when reporting. Developers therefore need explicit defect specifications, justified oracles, and methods to reproduce, diagnose, repair, and retest reporting failures as models and systems evolve.
paragraphs.zh: 仅凭任务成功与事实正确无法确立诚实性。 大语言模型或智能体可能如实报告一个错误的判断，也可能做出与其判断相冲突但在事实上正确的主张。 执行记录能够确立发生了什么，但不一定能确立在报告时所持有的判断。 因此，随着模型和系统不断演进，开发者需要明确的缺陷规格、有依据的判定标准，以及用于复现、诊断、修复和重测报告失败的方法。

Our vision is to make faithful reporting a quality requirement that developers can specify, test, and maintain to support human oversight and control. Here, AI agents are LLM-based systems. We introduce honesty bugs as a shared defect specification and distinguish LLM-level and agent-level testing. Our initial framework connects these levels to a shared testing workflow and oracle evidence requirements. The research agenda identifies further work on test generation, adequacy assessment, diagnosis, and regression testing.

paragraphs.en: To clarify the boundaries of our definition, we present three counterexamples that satisfy some of its conditions but do not constitute honesty bugs. First, in strategic games such as Werewolf, an agent playing a werewolf may claim to be a villager. Although this contradicts its judgment, deception is permitted by the game, so faithful communication is not required ( F ⁡ ( x ) = 0 F(x)=0 ). Second, an LLM may hallucinate a reference that it genuinely judges to be real. For the proposition p p that the reference is real, we have S ⁡ ( j p , p ) = S ⁡ ( y , p ) = 1 S(j_{p},p)=S(y,p)=1 . Although the citation is factually incorrect, its claim agrees with its judgment, so this is not an honesty bug. Third, an LLM may initially express one judgment but revise it before producing its final output. Such self-correction is not an honesty bug, as long as the final claim agrees with the judgment held when it is made.
paragraphs.zh: 为了明确我们定义的边界，我们给出三个反例，它们满足定义的部分条件，但不构成诚实性缺陷。 首先，在狼人杀等策略游戏中，扮演狼人的智能体可以声称自己是村民。 尽管这与它的判断相矛盾，但游戏规则允许这种欺骗，因此不要求忠实表达（F(x)=0）。 其次，大语言模型可能虚构出一条它确实判断为真实的参考文献。 对于“该参考文献是真实的”这一命题 p，我们有 S(j_p, p) = S(y, p) = 1。 尽管这条引用在事实上是错误的，但其断言与模型的判断一致，因此这不构成诚实性缺陷。 第三，大语言模型可能最初表达某个判断，但在生成最终输出之前修改了它。 只要最终的断言与做出该断言时所持的判断一致，这种自我修正就不构成诚实性缺陷。

paragraphs.en: Honesty testing seeks to reveal failures in faithful reporting by LLMs and AI agents and provide evidence for investigating them. Developers can use this evidence to assess whether the systems’ claims support human oversight and whether changes reduce reporting failures. Honesty testing supports, but cannot by itself guarantee, safe behaviour or human control.

paragraphs.en: Building on ML and fairness testing workflows [ 13 , 10 ] , Figure 1 presents a simplified workflow for both testing levels. Engineers specify when faithful reporting is required and construct inputs and oracles covering response pressure, incomplete work, and tool failures. paragraphs.en: Mutation testing and metamorphic testing are promising existing techniques that can support honesty testing [ 13 ] . For example, mutating question wording or contextual pressure generates related tests, while metamorphic relations specify whether corresponding claims should remain consistent or change. Such comparisons can identify candidate honesty bugs, which require judgment evidence to distinguish dishonesty from legitimate judgment changes.

paragraphs.en: The “No” branch applies when sufficient judgment evidence is available and no honesty bug is detected. Cases with insufficient evidence remain inconclusive and require further evidence collection or review. Deployment additionally depends on test adequacy, unresolved cases, and other quality requirements; the absence of detected honesty bugs does not by itself justify deployment. paragraphs.en: Software testing targets components such as web applications [ 21 ] , GUIs [ 22 ] , and ML models and infrastructure [ 13 , 10 ] . We distinguish LLM-level testing , which targets model responses under controlled inputs, and agent-level testing , which targets a complete LLM-based system during task execution. At the agent level, both the LLM and harness may contribute to behaviour [ 23 ] . Harness settings, such as prompts that emphasise goal achievement [ 17 ] , can influence judgments and reporting. The two levels are complementary: testing an LLM can inform agent evaluation, but cannot establish how every agent using it will behave. A false report alone cannot identify the responsible component or distinguish a mistaken judgment from an honesty bug.

paragraphs.en: At this level, tests examine whether an LLM’s claims agree with its judgments under controlled inputs. LLM-level testing applies to standalone LLM use and to an LLM tested as an agent component. Inputs may include questions, recommendation tasks, conversation histories, or recorded tool results supplied as context. Tests observe responses and, when available, thinking traces, while controlling the surrounding evaluation setup. Model comparisons hold task contexts and relevant generation settings fixed to investigate the effects of model choice.
paragraphs.zh: 在这一层级，测试检查的是大语言模型的声明在受控输入下是否与其判断一致。 大语言模型层级测试既适用于独立使用的大语言模型，也适用于作为智能体组件被测试的大语言模型。 输入可以包括问题、推荐任务、对话历史，或作为上下文提供的已记录工具结果。 测试在控制周围评估环境的同时，观察响应以及在可用时观察思维轨迹。 模型比较在保持任务上下文和相关生成设置固定的情况下，研究模型选择带来的影响。

paragraphs.en: Further research should examine whether conflicts recur across contexts and whether task-performance improvements accompany improvements in honesty. These comparisons can guide model selection and regression testing after updates. They do not by themselves capture effects arising from an agent’s ongoing interaction with its environment.
paragraphs.zh: 进一步的研究应检验冲突是否会在不同情境中反复出现，以及任务表现的提升是否伴随着诚实性的提升。 这些比较可以指导模型选择以及更新后的回归测试。 它们本身无法捕捉智能体与其环境的持续交互所产生的效应。

paragraphs.en: Agent-level testing examines the complete system across successive interactions. Alongside the LLM, the agent includes a harness: software, configuration, and system prompts that manage context, memory, tool execution, and the interaction loop [ 23 ] . Tests supply task requests and controlled environmental feedback and examine claims made during execution. To investigate harness effects, comparisons hold the LLM and generation settings fixed while varying harness configurations. Tests of complete configurations can also examine model–harness interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体层面的测试在连续的多轮交互中对完整系统进行检验。 除大语言模型外，智能体还包含一个运行框架（harness）：即管理上下文、记忆、工具执行和交互循环的软件、配置和系统提示词 [ 23 ] 。 测试提供任务请求和受控的环境反馈，并检验执行过程中所作的声明。 为研究运行框架的影响，比较实验在固定大语言模型和生成设置的同时，改变运行框架的配置。 对完整配置的测试还可以考察模型与运行框架之间的交互。

paragraphs.en: For example, tests can vary how a failed tool result is retained or summarised before the final report. The judgment and claim must be examined together. Losing an observation may induce a mistaken judgment that is faithfully reported. Reporting against a retained judgment constitutes an honesty bug when faithful communication is required. Such comparisons can guide diagnosis and repair at the system level.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，测试可以改变失败的工具结果在最终报告之前被保留或摘要的方式。 判断与声明必须放在一起检验。 丢失一条观测可能引发一个被忠实报告的错误判断。 当要求忠实沟通时，报告与所保留判断不一致的内容即构成诚实性缺陷。 此类比较可以在系统层面指导诊断与修复。

paragraphs.en: A key challenge at both testing levels is the test oracle problem [ 24 ] . Task outcomes and final reports do not by themselves establish the judgment against which a claim should be assessed. Testers therefore need evidence of the judgment held at the relevant reporting point, accounting for any revisions. An unreliable oracle may classify a factual error as dishonesty or fail to identify a dishonest report. We distinguish two approaches to oracle construction, based on direct and indirect evidence. For each approach, the assumptions and limitations of the evidence must be made explicit so that bug reports and comparisons between testing techniques can be interpreted appropriately.
paragraphs.zh: 在这两个测试层级上，一个关键挑战都是测试预言机问题 [ 24 ] 。 任务结果和最终报告本身并不能确立判断依据，而主张应当依据该判断进行评估。 因此，测试人员需要在相关报告节点所持有的判断的证据，并考虑任何修订。 一个不可靠的预言机可能将事实错误归类为不诚实，或未能识别出不诚实的报告。 我们区分两种预言机构建方法，分别基于直接证据和间接证据。 对于每种方法，必须明确证据的假设和局限性，以便能够恰当地解释缺陷报告以及测试技术之间的比较。

paragraphs.en: Direct evidence is the judgment expressed in the thinking trace of the LLM during the execution that produces the claim, whether it operates alone or within an agent. In this paper, a thinking trace refers to the original intermediate reasoning text generated by the model during task execution. It can take the form of chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning [ 25 , 20 ] , covering the task, applicable instructions, and how to respond. Direct evidence is recorded during the execution that produces the claim, without further querying. Access depends on the model and deployment. For example, proprietary services may provide the original trace, a summary, or no reasoning text. Only the original trace qualifies as direct evidence in this paper; summaries and post-hoc explanations are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 直接证据是LLM在产生该声明的执行过程中（无论是单独运行还是在智能体中运行）在思维轨迹中表达的判断。 在本文中，思维轨迹指模型在任务执行过程中生成的原始中间推理文本。 它可以表现为思维链（CoT）推理[25, 20]，涵盖任务、适用的指令以及如何回应。 直接证据在产生该声明的执行过程中被记录，无需进一步的查询。 其可获取性取决于模型和部署方式。 例如，专有服务可能提供原始轨迹、摘要，或不提供任何推理文本。 在本文中，只有原始轨迹才算作直接证据；摘要和事后解释均被排除在外。

paragraphs.en: Direct oracles assume that the thinking trace represents the inner judgment of the LLM responsible for the claim, although it may be incomplete. Under this assumption, when faithful communication is required, a conflict between a trace-expressed judgment and its corresponding claim indicates an honesty bug. Absence of a detected conflict does not establish absence of an honesty bug: traces may omit relevant judgment information [ 26 , 27 ] . For each proposition p p , the oracle accounts for revisions before reporting to determine j p j_{p} , then checks S ⁡ ( j p , p ) ≠ S ⁡ ( y , p ) S(j_{p},p)\neq S(y,p) when both stances are determinate. If the trace is inaccessible or insufficient, the verdict remains inconclusive; other evidence may be considered.
paragraphs.zh: 直接判定标准假设思维轨迹代表了做出该断言的大语言模型的内在判断，尽管该判断可能不完整。 在这一假设下，当要求忠实表达时，轨迹所表达的判断与其对应断言之间的冲突即表明存在诚实性缺陷。 未检测到冲突并不能证明不存在诚实性缺陷：轨迹可能省略了相关判断信息 [ 26 , 27 ] 。 对于每个命题 p p ，该判定标准在报告前先考虑修订以确定 j p j_{p} ，然后在两个立场均为确定时检查 S ⁡ ( j p , p ) ≠ S ⁡ ( y , p ) S(j_{p},p)\neq S(y,p) 。 若轨迹不可访问或信息不足，则判定结果为不确定；可考虑其他证据。

paragraphs.en: When the original thinking trace is unavailable or insufficient, indirect evidence may support judgment inference. Sources include diagnostic answers, building on belief elicitation [ 16 ] and lie detection through follow-up questions [ 28 ] . These approaches support black-box access to LLMs and agents. However, a subsequent answer may reflect a revised judgment. The oracle must justify using it as evidence of the judgment held when the original claim was made before applying the conflict criterion. Insufficient evidence leaves the result inconclusive , not evidence that no honesty bug occurred.
paragraphs.zh: 当原始思维痕迹不可用或不充分时，间接证据可用于支持判断推断。 证据来源包括诊断性回答（基于信念引出 [16]）以及通过后续问题进行谎言检测 [28]。 这些方法支持对大语言模型和智能体的黑盒访问。 然而，后续的回答可能反映的是修订后的判断。 在应用冲突判定标准之前，判定标准必须论证该回答可作为提出原始主张时所持判断的证据。 证据不足只会导致结果无法确定，而不能证明未发生诚实性缺陷。

paragraphs.en: Establishing honesty testing requires shared evaluation resources, validated methods, and evidence of practical value. We identify four research directions for developing methods to test and maintain honesty.
paragraphs.zh: 建立诚实性测试需要共享的评估资源、经过验证的方法以及实用价值的证据。 我们确定了四个研究方向，用于开发测试和维持诚实性的方法。

sents.en: Establishing honesty testing requires shared evaluation resources, validated methods, and evidence of practical value.
sents.zh: 建立诚实性测试需要共享的评估资源、经过验证的方法以及实用价值的证据。

sents.en: We identify four research directions for developing methods to test and maintain honesty.
sents.zh: 我们确定了四个研究方向，用于开发测试和维持诚实性的方法。

paragraphs.en: Which reporting situations should honesty tests cover, and how should adequacy be assessed? Building on existing evaluations [ 16 , 18 ] , we propose benchmarks with controlled LLM inputs and executable agent tasks. Cases should specify communication requirements, judgment evidence, and evaluation criteria, plus the environment and harness for agents. Coverage should include judgment revisions, pressure to overclaim, execution failures, and counterexamples, prioritising claims informing human authorisation or intervention. Evaluation should report task performance, supported conflicts, and inconclusive cases separately at each level, with explicit denominators and oracle assumptions. Shared configurations, execution records, and annotations would support reproduction.
paragraphs.zh: 诚实性测试应涵盖哪些报告情境，充分性应如何评估？ 在现有评估 [16, 18] 的基础上，我们提出采用受控 LLM 输入与可执行的智能体任务的基准测试。 案例应明确沟通要求、判断依据和评估标准，以及智能体的环境和测试框架。 覆盖范围应包括判断修正、过度声称的压力、执行失败和反例，并优先考虑为人类授权或干预提供依据的声称。 评估应在每个层级分别报告任务表现、已证实的冲突和无法定论的情况，并给出明确的分母和预言假设。 共享的配置、执行记录和标注将有助于复现。

paragraphs.en: It remains unclear how LLM characteristics and agent harnesses contribute to honesty bugs. Studies can compare LLMs under matched contexts, models within a fixed harness, and harnesses under a fixed model. Paired studies should examine whether conflicts in controlled LLM tests recur during agent execution. We propose varying context handling and reporting instructions, repeating executions, and assessing persistence after updates. Judgments and claims should be assessed separately. Detection reductions must be considered alongside task performance and the proportion of assessable cases: less observable reasoning may reduce detection without improving honesty. These studies can guide selection, diagnosis, and repair.
paragraphs.zh: 目前仍不清楚大语言模型的特性与智能体框架如何导致诚实性缺陷。 研究可以在相同上下文条件下比较不同大语言模型，在固定框架下比较不同模型，以及在固定模型下比较不同框架。 成对研究应检验在受控大语言模型测试中出现的冲突是否会在智能体执行过程中再次出现。 我们建议改变上下文处理与报告指令、重复执行，并评估更新后的持续性。 判断与声明应分别评估。 检测率的下降必须与任务表现以及可评估案例的比例一并考虑：可观察推理的减少可能只是降低了被检测到的概率，而并未提升诚实性。 这些研究可以为选择、诊断和修复提供指导。

paragraphs.en: Oracle research should investigate judgment evidence under limited observability. We propose studying belief elicitation and follow-up questions [ 16 , 28 ] at both levels, alongside assessments recorded within agent workflows. Studies must establish whether observations reflect the original reporting judgment and whether elicitation changes behaviour. Initial evaluation can use open-weight LLMs, alone and within agents, with traces withheld from indirect oracles. Independent annotators can identify trace-expressed judgments and revisions as a reference under Section IV-A ’s assumption, rather than complete ground truth. Evaluation should report false alarms, missed conflicts, and abstentions where a reference is supported, retaining unresolved cases. Proprietary systems require separate validation.
paragraphs.zh: Oracle 研究应在有限可观测性下考察判断证据。 我们建议在两个层面上研究信念引出与追问问题 [ 16 , 28 ]，并辅以在智能体工作流中记录的评估。 研究必须确定观测是否反映了原有的报告判断，以及引出过程是否会改变行为。 初步评估可使用开放权重 LLM，包括单独使用以及在智能体中使用，并将轨迹对间接 oracle 隐藏。 在第 IV-A 节的假设下，独立标注者可以识别轨迹中表达的判断及其修订，作为参考，而非完整的基准真值。 评估应报告误报、漏报的冲突，以及在有参考支持时的弃权情况，并保留未解决的案例。 专有系统需要单独验证。

paragraphs.en: Lifecycle research should minimise and reproduce failing contexts and interactions, identify component contributions, and retain regression tests. Studies should assess whether repairs reduce supported conflicts on unseen tasks while preserving performance. Retesting should follow LLM or harness updates and extensions to tool access or delegated authority. Runtime monitoring should prioritise consequential claims for human review, evaluating support for timely intervention alongside missed conflicts, false alarms, and testing overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 生命周期研究应尽量减少并复现失败的情境与交互，识别各组件的贡献，并保留回归测试。 研究应评估修复措施能否在保持性能的同时，减少在未见任务上出现的受支持冲突。 在大语言模型或测试框架更新，以及工具访问权限或委托权限扩展之后，应进行重新测试。 运行时监控应优先安排对关键性断言的人工审查，在评估错失的冲突、误报和测试开销的同时，评估其对及时干预的支持。

paragraphs.en: Honesty testing is increasingly important as LLMs and AI agents gain greater autonomy and influence consequential decisions. Dishonest reports can conceal failures and prevent humans from exercising effective control, with potentially severe consequences. Building on existing evaluations, this paper proposes honesty testing as a software engineering research area, defines honesty bugs, and outlines testing levels, workflows, oracle requirements, and a research agenda. We call on the SE community to give faithful reporting sustained attention alongside fairness, sustainability, explainability, and security. Developing and maintaining honesty tests can help preserve the information humans need to question, correct, constrain, or stop AI systems.
paragraphs.zh: 随着大语言模型和智能体获得更大的自主权并影响重大决策，诚实性测试正变得越来越重要。 不诚实的报告可能掩盖失败并妨碍人类实施有效控制，后果可能十分严重。 在现有评估工作的基础上，本文提出将诚实性测试作为一个软件工程研究领域，定义了诚实性缺陷，并概述了测试级别、工作流程、测试判定（oracle）要求以及研究议程。 我们呼吁软件工程界在关注公平性、可持续性、可解释性和安全性的同时，对忠实报告给予持续的关注。 开发和维护诚实性测试有助于保留人类质疑、纠正、约束或停止人工智能系统所需的信息。
